title: query_index in ContactStore produces non-deterministic results for contacts with identical peer_login
description: ContactStore::query_index() counts contacts whose peer_login sorts strictly before the target contact's peer_login (c2.peer_login < c1.peer_login). If two contacts share the same peer_login value (e.g. both have empty login names on a Headscale deployment without OIDC), both would receive the same index. This means Contact/queryChanges would report incorrect insertion positions for the duplicate. The JMAP RFC requires positions to be deterministic. Fix: add a secondary tie-breaking column to the ORDER BY (e.g. peer_user_id), matching the sort order used in list(). Note: the list() method currently only orders by peer_login with no tie-break. Both query_index and list() should be aligned on the same deterministic composite sort key.
